# Proof System

Proof turns brand claims into reasons to trust NINEONELABS. Do not say we are different; show what makes the work different.

## Proof Formula

```text
Claim -> Evidence -> Client Result
```

Example:

```text
We build immersive web experiences -> Three.js runs inside the production site -> Users remember the brand through interaction, not a static page.
```

## Proof Types

### Shipped Work

Use for portfolio, case study, and services proof.

- live site
- campaign page
- app flow
- brand system
- CMS structure
- launched interaction

### Technical Capability

Use in `why` or proposal copy.

- Three.js
- GSAP
- TypeScript
- custom MVC / backend ownership
- CMS / Webflow
- performance and SEO structure

### Interaction / System Quality

Use when explaining why the experience feels different.

- scroll-triggered motion
- user flow
- reusable components
- design system
- responsive behavior
- structured content

### Operational Continuity

Use for Orbit and Maintenance.

- bug fixes
- CMS updates
- performance audits
- stability checks
- iteration cycles

### Measurable Outcome

Use only when there is a real or defensible measurement.

- faster load
- improved conversion path
- reduced support friction
- easier content updates
- stronger search visibility

## Skill Label Rule

Skill labels in `why` are proof signals. They should be short and scannable.

Good:

- `THREE.JS / INTERACTIVE WEB`
- `GSAP / MOTION & ANIMATION`
- `CMS SYSTEM / CONTENT CONTROL`

Weak:

- `We use Three.js to make cool websites`
- `Latest animation technology`
- `Best SEO solution`

## Proof Writing Rules

- Never list a tool without showing why it matters.
- Never use proof language for decoration.
- If proof becomes a service description, move it to `services.md`.
- If proof cannot be connected to a client result, remove or rewrite it.

- 차별화된 결과를 보장합니다.
